decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 25th May 2006, an erection of a roof extension with dormer window of 21.22m3 which would give a total volume increase to the original house of 54.49m3, as shown on drawing numbers 009/FAU/001, received 25th May 2006, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed erection of a roof extension with dormer window, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Classes B and C of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
Condition : 2 - The proposed roof extension must not be higher than any part of the existing ridge of the roof. The original ridgeline and ridge capping of the house should be maintained.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of roof extension to house
